PRIVACY

A little clarity about your information.

How we handle the information you share when you contact Reachup Media.

Campaign enquiries

When you submit a campaign enquiry, this website forwards your details to our business email inbox through our email provider. We use your enquiry to respond and discuss your campaign. We do not store enquiries in a website database. If you choose WhatsApp instead, your details open in a prepared message that you decide whether to send.

What you share

The enquiry can include your name, work email, brand, website, budget, timeline and campaign brief. Please share only the information needed for an initial conversation.

Animation preferences

Animations automatically follow your device’s reduced-motion preference. The site does not save a separate animation setting or send your device preference to Reachup Media.

Instagram previews

Creator-content previews load from Instagram only after you choose “Load Reel preview”. Loading a preview connects your browser to Instagram, where Instagram’s privacy terms and cookie policies apply. You can use “View on Instagram” instead.

Other services

Links to Instagram, LinkedIn, WhatsApp and email open external services. Their privacy terms apply when you use them. The site hosting provider may process technical request information necessary to serve this website.

Questions

For questions about information you share with Reachup Media, contact letstalk@reachupmedia.in.
